verdict.rationale: An in-product AI tax assistant is a fair question for a tax-compliance SaaS, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents Stripe Tax shipping one. The `taxability_reason` API field explains tax results, but it is a structured data field, not an AI that answers questions with citations. The official MCP server and llms.txt are developer building blocks for external agents, not the product's own AI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the product ships its own AI for tax questions — is this product taxable in this state, why did this invoice tax this way — answering from its rule base with citations, not a generic chatbot
